{{Top|leg}}
The '''Walking cephalopod''' was a type of [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopod]] that existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carida/Legends|Carida]]. In [[44 ABY]], it was one of the creatures featured in the [[Javat Caridan Children's Animal Habitat]] where children can learn more about it.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
